subject.title: PR5/5 durable core: internal session delivery handoff

question: Should the release branch adopt this cumulative opt-in durable-runtime architecture and its new persisted, Gateway, CLI, and startup-recovery surfaces?
rationale: The branch establishes broad new product and compatibility contracts; tests cannot determine whether maintainers want this architecture or its proposed release sequence.

options.title: Sponsor the durable stack
options.body: Approve the architecture and require dependency-ordered landing after immutable tooling and exact-head upgrade/restart proof.

options.title: Require narrower branches
options.body: Accept durable recovery only through independently reviewable foundation and session-handoff PRs rather than this cumulative branch.

options.title: Pause the direction
options.body: Do not land the durable runtime until maintainers choose another recovery design or roadmap slot.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the durable stack
recommendation.body: Approve the architecture and require dependency-ordered landing after immutable tooling and exact-head upgrade/restart proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This account is the only maintainer-side routing signal visible in the supplied latest PR timeline.
